Supply that token to console through PULSE_CONSOLE_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE without printing it, run the command, finish setup and open /checks/check?id=nightly-backup, an HTTP check detail, /checks/new?type=http and /checks/edit?id=<a Console HTTP check>. HTTP detail shows readable Settings labels; populated Recent results has .mmm UTC times and the R3 note. Both HTTP forms show Headers and JSON assertions open without a click. Record API and console commands, opened paths and actual observations in the PR, then stop processes. If pulse-api cannot run, name its actual error, still run this console command and record startup and /setup observations, then add the fixture exercise below. A fixture-only run does not satisfy this acceptance. Float/negative-budget behavior is covered by automated tests rather than manufactured real API data.
